name: Visit the Herbalist
summary: Guard Parker sends you to buy flowers for Darcy before you return to the Lakeshire inn. He wants the gift to stay secret.

sections.title: A Guard's Secret Request
sections.body: At his post on Lakeshire's southern approach, Guard Parker watches for blackrock orcs and gnolls. You bring him a warm meal from Darcy at the Lakeshire Inn. Grateful for her kindness, Parker asks you to stop at the herbalist shop on the west end of town and buy flowers for her.

sections.title: Town Gossip and Secret Courting
sections.body: Parker asks you to keep the order private when you visit Martie Jainrose, the herbalist. Lakeshire is a small town, and he does not want Martie to know who sent the flowers or who will receive them. At the shop, Martie teases you, guessing you have already found a sweetheart in town. With orc incursions and brigands troubling Redridge, a small gesture of romance brings some welcome relief.

faq.q: Who sends you to visit the herbalist?
faq.answer: Guard Parker, stationed on the southern road into the Redridge Mountains just north of Duskwood, sends you to the herbalist.

faq.q: Who is the herbalist in Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Martie Jainrose is Lakeshire's herbalist and florist. Her shop is at the western end of town.

faq.q: Why does Guard Parker want flowers?
faq.answer: Parker wants to thank Darcy, the Lakeshire Inn waitress who sent him a free lunch, and show his romantic interest with flowers.

faq.q: Why does Parker want the purchase kept secret?
aliases: why hide who flowers are for
faq.answer: Parker feels bashful about courting Darcy and wants to keep the purchase from Martie Jainrose and the other townsfolk.

faq.q: What happens after talking to Martie Jainrose?
faq.answer: Martie prepares a bouquet of daffodils for you to take to Darcy at the Lakeshire Inn.

faq.q: Where does this fit in the quest chain?
faq.answer: This visit follows 'A Free Lunch', when you bring lunch to Guard Parker, and comes before 'Delivering Daffodils', when you carry the flowers back to Darcy.

angles.text: Martie Jainrose is Lakeshire's herbalism and alchemy merchant, at the western edge of town.
Gnoll packs and blackrock orcs threaten Redridge, while romance still finds a place among Lakeshire's defenders.
